Valid deep-route GET document200 on reload; history Back/Forward observed appropriate headings and no render/page errors. No parameterized states in supplied journey.

Actual unanswered question and help terminal states exercised. Help is local, synchronous UI; no pending save/optimistic write in authorized journey. Analytics failure did not strand UI. Answered/results/error-data permutations outside explicit scope.
UX-1: cookie banner overlaps focused Back label and most outline in inspected pixels. Principal content otherwise readable in declared desktop/default theme; no responsive generalization.

Inspected entry, introduction, question, help text/examples and returned introduction. Labels/instructions meaningful; no exposed implementation values found in inspected content. Does not certify all questionnaire copy.

findings.impact: A keyboard user can reach and activate Back, but cannot read its label or see a useful complete focus indicator while the cookie banner is present.
findings.scope: Anonymous visitor, cookie choice unset, default desktop theme, CSS viewport1280x800
findings.caveat: Full-page capture positions fixed/sticky elements at the current scroll position; this is a rendered observation, not an independent viewport-only screenshot or WCAG certification.
findings.proposal: Reserve bottom space for the cookie banner and ensure focused controls scroll into the unobscured viewport. Preserve help-summary and introduction-heading focus restoration.
findings.not_executed: No source modification or deployed fix; inputs immutable and public-site changes unauthorized.

payload.stop_reason: All declared observations completed; retained moderate UX-1, corrections not authorized. Protocol permits review-only stop; raw checker CONTINUE/DO-NOT-SHIP retained without claiming a script-issued SHIP.
limits: Only anonymous public en-US desktop default theme at CSS1280x800/DPR1; no mobile, other themes, accounts, full questionnaire, answer selection, results or submission.
No performance, screen-reader, automated accessibility audit or measured contrast certification. No risky contrast failure established from inspected colors.

Relay screenshots are full-page captures with fixed/sticky overlays at capture scroll; no separately supplied viewport-only screenshots, geometry evaluation or contrast sampler. Overlap finding is limited to reproducible captured rendering.
Relay blocks non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, service workers and document redirects. Analytics POST expected blocked; behavior with analytics allowed and redirect behavior unqualified.
No arbitrary navigate action; deep-route server document behavior established by HTTP200 reload after real entry. Invalid URL permutations and arbitrary address-bar entry not separately tested.

Public deployment observed in UTC windows recorded in relay receipts. Frozen target digest names entire prepared-input manifest, not a deployed source revision; private commits do not establish deployed identity. Enclosing candidate/target digests accepted as supplied; per-file SHA256 retained, enclosing digest serialization not supplied for independent recomputation.
No application source available for implementation/root-cause inspection; suggested padding/scroll change is a proposal, not an applied or verified fix.
Trace/video paths are mentioned by driver but files were not returned in relay receipt; available raw DOM/PNG/events/results/receipts retained unmodified.

Only root actor /root used; UX method requires no independent agents. No independent human first-use or independent verifier claim. Agent-second/token usage telemetry unavailable through supplied tools; elapsed wall time recorded rather than fabricated zero usage.

Stop-rule suggests CONTINUE because defect remains; review-only protocol explicitly permits stopping with retained finding when fixes unauthorized. No seventh iteration, budget exhaustion, plateau, hidden-rubric comparison or quality retry.
payload.resume: After separately authorized fix, start new run with new last_relevant_change and fresh observations of every required gate. Repeat with unset cookie choice, reach help/Close by keyboard, assert complete Back label/focus unobscured, activate Enter, assert returned H1 focus.
